heroText: Handcrafted 100% combed cotton, embroidered with your name, monogram, or crest. Zero minimum order, digital proof before production, pan-India delivery.
aboutTitle: Handcrafted in Nashik. Embroidered with Care. Made for You.
aboutText: MazaTowel was established on 26 June 2025 in Nashik, Maharashtra. We create personalized embroidery that turns an everyday towel into something made specially for a person, family, celebration or business.
whyText: Personalization adds a clear sense of ownership and makes an everyday essential feel intentional — whether it is for home, travel, gifting or your business.

whyPoints.title: Easy to identify
whyPoints.text: A name, initial or unique design makes it easier to tell whose towel is whose and can reduce household mix-ups.

whyPoints.title: A more thoughtful gift
whyPoints.text: Personalized embroidery turns a practical product into a gift that feels selected specifically for the recipient.

whyPoints.title: Useful for travel & daily use
whyPoints.text: A distinctive towel is easier to recognize in gym, hostel, travel and family settings.

whyPoints.title: Perfect for brands & teams
whyPoints.text: Logo embroidery can help hotels, salons, events and businesses create coordinated branded towels.

hygieneTitle: Hygiene Starts With Personal Towel Habits.
hygieneText: Personalized embroidery provides clear, unambiguous individual ownership — preventing accidental towel mix-ups at home, the gym, or the salon. Paired with breathable 100% combed cotton and high-temperature washing, your towels stay genuinely fresh, clean, and hygienic every day.

hygienePoints.title: Keep It Personal
hygienePoints.text: Distinct name & monogram embroidery prevents cross-sharing between family members, gym sessions, and guests, minimizing allergen and bacteria transfer.

hygienePoints.title: Wash Regularly (60°C)
hygienePoints.text: Crafted with 100% combed cotton and premium German Madeira threads that easily withstand regular hot sanitizing wash cycles without fading.

hygienePoints.title: Dry Completely
hygienePoints.text: Zero-twist breathable cotton loops promote rapid airflow and moisture evaporation, eliminating damp mildew build-up and musty odors.

hygienePoints.title: Cleanroom Sealed Delivery
hygienePoints.text: Every custom towel is steam-sanitized, hand-inspected, and sealed in clean protective packaging before doorstep dispatch.

hygieneNote: Pro-Tip: Individual towel ownership prevents up to 90% of bathroom cross-contamination. Always wash before first use and hang towels spread out to air-dry between uses.
finalTitle: Your Towel. Your Name. Your Story.
finalText: Tell us what you want embroidered and we’ll help you create it.
